Recommended in _Where_Should_We_Camp_Next?_ by Stephanie Puglisi
Corps of Engineers campground on Nolin River Lake, now run by Wax Marina across the road. The waterfront electric row (A3, A5, A7, A8, A10-A13) and the primitive C-loop waterfront sites (C19-C28) sit on open ground sloping gently to the summer shoreline 20-45 m away; the B loop and upper A loop are wooded and away from the water. Federal passes are not honored; the marina gives 10% off to pass holders, seniors, military, first responders and guests with disabilities on request by email with proof. A sand swim beach is planned for 2027. --Claude

WATERFRONT lakefront CONFIRMED. Campspot sells 8 'Standard Waterfront RV Site' W/E sites nightly (A003, A005, A007, A008, A010, A011, A012, A013) and 7 'Primitive Waterfront RV/Tent Site' (C019, C020, C021, C023, C025, C026, C028). 3DEP vs Nolin summer pool 515 ft (157.0 m): A008 (37.342688,-86.130147) pad 160.0 m, pool line 20 m away over a smooth ~9 deg open slope (159.2 at 7 m, 158.5 at 10 m, 157.6 at 15 m); A003 (37.342773,-86.129392) 160.6 m, pool at 17-20 m; A007 (37.342706,-86.129897) 160.4 m, pool at 22-25 m; A005/A012 25 m; A010/A011 35 m; C019-C028 25-45 m. Imagery (drawdown) shows open, lightly treed ground from these pads to the shoreline, no road or screen. A 3-3.7 m rise over a gentle open slope is an easy kayak carry, unlike Waitsboro's 4.6 m over 15 m (same batch). Suggested evidence: 'Campspot 2026-11-24 sells A003/A005/A007/A008/A010-A013 as Standard Waterfront RV Sites; 3DEP: pads 160.0-160.8 m, Nolin summer pool (157.0 m) 20-35 m away over a ~9 deg open slope with no bank; imagery open to the shoreline = lakefront'.
